title: Name a colour
summary: A Sass variable gives a value a name. The dollar sign starts that name.
introduction: A Sass variable gives a value a name. The dollar sign starts that name. Your task: Change the ink colour and rebuild the CSS file.
learningObjectives: Change the ink colour and rebuild the CSS file.
Explain the example for name a colour

blocks.text: A Sass variable gives a value a name. The dollar sign starts that name. You can reuse one colour without typing its code each time.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: `$ink` stores the colour used by both rules. Sass replaces that name with the colour when it builds CSS.
`h1` and `a` remain normal CSS selectors in the output.

blocks.text: Both h1 and a rules use #174a8b in the CSS output. The $ink name is replaced during the build.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A Sass variable is chosen while building CSS. It is different from a CSS custom property that the browser can change.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the ink colour and rebuild the CSS file.
